lessons: replay.py main() must exit nonzero when any selected scenario's outcome is "reproduced". A Regression command that exits 0 at the merge base can never pass the section 13 bug gate. Read section 13's `## Regression`/`carries:` spec before editing.

Keep the always-on `fixture-replay` mechanical check green on the unfixed base. For example, have the no-arg run cover only scenarios expected to pass, or give it a mode that reports without failing. Only `--scenario report-to-regression` should go red while the defect exists.

In bin/codex's authored bug ticket, `carries:` must never name app.py, the file the fix changes. Have the canned implement add a regression test or fixture file inside the authored fence, point the Regression command at it, and carry only that file.

Add tests that run `bin/fixture-replay --scenario report-to-regression`: assert a nonzero exit on the unfixed copy and exit 0 after the scripted implement in the temp worktree. Also assert the authored ticket's `carries:` excludes app.py.

Keep everything that already passed review: the fence, header-parsed surfaces, per-scenario canned answers, exact report byte counts, the escape living only in the canned implement, and the fixture-serve PATH/key stripping. Change no engine module.
reason: Review found two concrete, fixable defects with clear fixes (replay's exit code and the carries target). The fence, the checks, and the other acceptance points all passed, so a same-capability retry should close them.
